lines.en: I decide to kill some time at the mall again.
lines.zh: 我决定又去商场消磨点时间。

lines.en: Chika is sitting on a bench when I get there and she quickly waves me over to come watch some video on her phone."
lines.zh: 我到的时候 Chika 正坐在长椅上，很快招手叫我过去看她手机上的视频。"

lines.en: She goes on to talk about a few new pop-stars and makeup tutorials and I basically just sit there and absorb her words, understanding very little."
lines.zh: 接着她讲起几个新出道的流行歌手和化妆教程，我基本上只是坐在那儿听，几乎什么都没听懂。"

lines.en: Despite the two of us having virtually nothing in common, I feel strangely comfortable with her...
lines.zh: 虽然我们俩几乎没有任何共同点，我在她身边却意外地自在……
